paras: Ialtris parishi, also known commonly as Parish's fanged snake and the Tiburon banded racer, is a species of snake in the subfamily Dipsadinae of the family Colubridae.  The species is native to Haiti.
The specific name, parishi, is in honor of Lee H. Parish (died 1931) who was a member of the expedition which collected the holotype.
The preferred natural habitat of Ialtris parishi is forest, at elevations of 13–243 m (43–797 ft).
